name: CGB
recent: Central Global Berhad 近期有多项企业活动：并委任新首席财务官。同时，董事与大股东在闭市期内外有多次股权买卖申报，另有凭单转换为新股上市。
notable: 委任 Shiow Yee 为首席财务官。
凭单 B 转换为 180,000 股新股，上市日为 2026-11-20。
risks: 董事 Lee Chee Vui 在 2026-11-12 至 2026-11-17 期间多次申报 acquire 与 dispose 股份。
董事 Chew Hian Tat 在 2026-11-12 至 2026-11-17 期间多次申报 acquire 与 dispose 股份。
大股东 HJT International Group (M) Sdn. Bhd.、Chew Hian Tat、Lee Chee Vui、Soo Yu Chai 及 RYRT Holdings Sdn. Bhd. 在 2026-11-13 至 2026-11-18 期间申报股权变动。
earnings: 2025-06-30 季度营收为 MYR 98.176 million，环比增长 27.3%；净利为 MYR 3.019 million，环比下降 22.4%；净利率从 5.0% 降至 3.1%。

events.what_en: Listing of new shares from warrant conversion

recent_en: Central Global Berhad has several recent corporate developments: it proposed a RM500mil Sukuk Mudharabah programme and appointed a new CFO. Meanwhile, directors and substantial shareholders reported multiple share dealings during and around the closed period, and new shares from warrant conversion were listed.
notable_en: Proposed establishment of a RM500mil Sukuk Mudharabah programme.
Appointed Shiow Yee as Chief Financial Officer.
Conversion of 180,000 Warrants B into new shares, with listing date on 20 Nov 2026.
risks_en: Director Lee Chee Vui reported multiple acquisitions and disposals of shares between 12 Nov 2026 and 17 Nov 2026.
Director Chew Hian Tat reported multiple acquisitions and disposals of shares between 12 Nov 2026 and 17 Nov 2026.

Substantial shareholders HJT International Group (M) Sdn. Bhd., Chew Hian Tat, Lee Chee Vui, Soo Yu Chai and RYRT Holdings Sdn. Bhd. reported changes in shareholdings between 13 Nov 2026 and 18 Nov 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2025, revenue was MYR 98.176 million, up 27.3% QoQ; net income was MYR 3.019 million, down 22.4% QoQ; net margin fell from 5.0% to 3.1%.
